definitions.explanation: inclination; slope; slant; the state of being tilted or leaning
a tendency or leaning toward something (figurative)

notes:
{傾|かたむ}き is the nominalized form of ⟦{傾|かたむ}く→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧ (to tilt, lean).

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL TILT:
- Describes the angle or slope of something
- Used for buildings, ground, furniture, etc.

SENSE 2 - FIGURATIVE TENDENCY:
- Describes a leaning or tendency toward something
- Used for attitudes, trends, policies

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傾|かたむ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す (to correct a tilt)
- {傾|かたむ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ (to measure the slope)
- ～な{傾|かたむ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a tendency toward ~)

MATHEMATICS/SCIENCE:
In mathematics, {傾|かたむ}き means "slope" (of a line or curve), as in:
- ⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傾|かたむ}き (slope of a line)
- {傾|かたむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角度|かくど}→角度：00156_kakudo⟧ (angle of inclination)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傾斜|けいしゃ}→傾斜：05447_keisha⟧: Inclination, slope (more formal/technical)
- {勾配|こうばい}: Gradient (technical term)
- ⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧: Tendency (for sense 2, more common)

REGISTER: Neutral.
